title: UI风格#34 - Aurora Borealis (极光流转)
description: 创建第34种UI风格：极光流转风格 - 北欧极光、流动色彩、冰晶质感。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planAH.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aurora Borealis style When color palette Then features northern lights greens, purples, pinks against dark sky
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#00FF87 (极光绿), #8B5CF6 (紫), #FF6B9D (粉), #0EA5E9 (冰蓝), #0F0F23 (夜空黑)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aurora Borealis style When typography Then uses elegant fonts: Josefin Sans, Montserrat, or Poppins
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Josefin Sans (标题), Montserrat (正文), Poppins (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aurora Borealis style When layout Then flowing gradients, aurora waves, ice crystal textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：极光渐变、流动波浪、冰晶纹理、北欧夜空

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aurora Borealis style When UI elements Then shimmer effects, aurora glow, frost borders, northern lights
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：微光效果、极光发光、冰霜边框、流动动画

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aurora Borealis UI When functional Then includes aurora chat, northern agents, shimmer stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：极光聊天、北欧代理、微光统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aurora Borealis UI When copy Then uses nordic nature: 'Aurora', 'Northern', 'Shimmer', 'Frost'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'AURORA. SHIMMER. FROST.'、按钮'SEND'→'GLITTER'、'SUBMIT'→'GLOW'
